summary: All five computed claims reproduced. The `no_valid_comparison` closure stands. The authors reported 31 hypothalamic DEGs after adjusting for body weight. The registered genotype-only model had zero genes at FDR < 0.05 among 13,040 published symbols. All 42 saved files matched their recorded sizes and SHA-256 values, but the purported GEO series page was a reCAPTCHA challenge. The genuine GEO SOFT and count archive independently confirmed all eight library assignments. The corrected proposal also records the byte-identical supplementary presentations, fixes a truncated checksum and clarifies when an effects-only comparison is possible. It passed the proposal validator. [Smith et al., sections 2.11 and 3.4](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9813750/)
openIssues: Author concordance remains unassessed. The reviewed sources yielded no identifiable author genotype-only effects or directions for the eight registered hypothalamus libraries.
